steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: I'm so bored... I want alcohol. Hey, the lad over there, yes, you! Get me a bottle of wine, bro, the best one you can get!

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: I'll pay you fair. As much tip as you want.
Before you even walk into the interrogation room, you hear the person yelling at the top of her voice from inside.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: I normally pay by carats, or... you want to be paid by pounds? Well, whatever. It's not that much money anyway.
Chelsea reclines in the chair for the interrogatee, looking bored stiff without the slightest hint of nervousness, as if she isn't under arrest but here on vacation.
As soon as you enter, the staff hurries away with a quick bow to you, as if you're their lifesaver, while Chelsea waves and greets you warmly.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Hey! Isn't this the Chief?! Welcome! Welcome!

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Would you be interested in sharing a glass of N.F.82 Campbell's with me?
Alcohol is strictly prohibited in the interrogation room.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Well, what a dull life it must be here then.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Chief, listen. I'll pay ten, no, twenty times the price! Just for one sip of wine from you. How does that sound?

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: If you're willing to feed me the sip of tea yourself, I'll pay a hundred times the price!
Forget it. It'll never happen.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Well, how about both of us take a step back. You'll be my sugar baby, and when I get back to my mansion, you'll have a whole cellar of choice wine to choose from.
Chelsea keeps mentioning her offer to be your "sugar mama" ever since she arrived at the MBCC.
You've already gone from being slightly irritated at first to being able to turn her down with a straight face.
And you can't go back to the Countess' Court until the investigation is over.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Aww... What a ruthless Chief—

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: But exactly the way I like about you! Heh heh—
Chelsea instinctively reaches out toward you, yet with her hands restrained, she can't go any further.
The sight of her hands and your poker face finally prompt Chelsea to sit up straight. Seems like she finally realizes this interrogation isn't a joke.

You place a thick pile of files in front of her, all filled with accusations against Countess Chelsea.

steps.speaker: Victim 1
steps.content: "She offered to be my sugar mama, and I... I refused. But she bought the company I work for, replaced everyone with staff she hired, and took all my work. Whatever I say, they would only ever reply—Please be the Countess' sugar baby."

steps.speaker: Victim 2
steps.content: "She wants me to be her sugar baby, and I said yes. But then I scratched my arm one time, and she told me she bought me a new arm and could install it anytime. Who in their right mind would do such a thing?!"

steps.speaker: Victim 3
steps.content: "Wh-What am I to her? It's not me that she likes!"
Several victims accused you of harassment, imprisonment, and causing great physical and psychological trauma. What do you have to say for yourself?

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Th-That's not harassment!

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: I like them, so I wanted to be their sugar mama and wanted them to be happy. That's all.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: And some of them said yes! How can that be imprisonment—? I mean, I don't understand why anyone would give up such a happy life for something else out there—it's so dangerous out there!
Chelsea furrows her brows, looking very frustrated, not feeling guilty at all about what she's been doing.
You're speechless. She doesn't seem to get that her so-called "happy life" is just drowning someone with money with no regard for what they think.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: All I want is to be nice to them, but they keep cursing me and rejecting me. Hmm. Yeah, guess I wasn't doing enough of it.
Why would they accuse you?

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: How should I know...

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Well then... How about you try being my sugar baby, Chief?

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: You won't know until you try, right?
Chelsea looks excited while the cuffs on her hands clank as she moves.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Chief, I have a question for you.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: What gem color do you like, Chief?
You pause at hearing this question completely irrelevant to the interrogation, failing to keep up with her jumpy train of thoughts.

options: This has nothing to do with the interrogation.

choices.text: This has nothing to do with the interrogation.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Come on! These cuffs are just too plain. They'll definitely look better with gems on!
She looks as if she's pondering some serious questions, staring at the cuffs, but it turns out she's thinking about adding gems to them...

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Look, Chief! I've got a lot of gems! How about I give them all to you to put on your cuffs?

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Aww! Chief's so cold...

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: But I like it.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: So... to show you my affection, how about I give you a few gems to put on the cuffs?

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Then you won't have to use cuffs that look so boring for all the other Sinners!
As Chelsea speaks, a string of sparkles shines in her hand. After the glow fades, several gems of various colors and excellent quality appear on her palm.

options: Please don't use your ability in the room.

steps.content: Or I'll use the shackles when necessary.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Come on! I just want you to have a better life. These gems are worth a lot of money. With them, you won't have to live in this crappy, tiny place anymore!
The Bureau is certainly no match for the Countess' Court, but I have no reason to leave here.
Hearing your rejection, not only does she not get upset, but she even smiles and leans forward.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Come on! Don't be so cold. Look, I can even let you and everyone else move into my mansion, with all the gourmet free to enjoy. Much better than this crappy place the Bureau has.
Sinners are not allowed to leave the Bureau without permission from the supervisors. Please be cooperative with our investigation.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Oh, are you worried that your bosses won't be happy about it? No worries, I know what to do. I'm really good at this...
You take a deep breath and fixate your gaze on her. Seeing that you're slightly agitated, Chelsea shrugs.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Let me just say one more thing...

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: I adore you with the utmost sincerity, Chief. If you're willing to be my sugar baby, I'll treat you especially well.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: I'll love you as much as I love Sitri. I won't let you suffer a tiny bit. I'll buy anything you want!
She talks about getting a sugar baby as if she's just buying a toy.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Sitri... Sitri... Oh, Sitri is my favorite cat—I have a huge bunch of cats in my backyard... They're all su-per cu-uute!

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: So? Are you tempted yet?
Thanks, but I'm more interested in finding out the truth behind the cases.
Chelsea bursts out laughing and tilts her head toward you to gaze at you, looking even more intrigued.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Cases. Those can hardly be called cases, right, Chief?
Well, why don't you take a look at this, Countess Chelsea?

Two weeks ago, the Eastside Public Security Bureau received three missing reports, which all pointed to you...
Countess Chelsea.
You place the photos of the missing people in front of her, at which she only takes a sideways glance.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Oh... It's them.
The sheriffs traced where they were last seen, and found that all three of them went back to the Countess's Court with you.
What do you have to say about this?

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Chief... There are many people in the world I want as my sugar babies, and I can afford them.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: But you, Chief, are my favorite out of all of them, of course!

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: So my home is actually kind of big and can fit many people... And you can just sleep whenever you're tired! How nice it is live in a place like that—

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Right—you, Chief, are the only one for the whole time, to refuse being my sugar baby and even to refuse my gifts. I'm so very sad that you don't want to live with me.
So, let me ask you this. Has this person been living in your... Countess' Court as well?
An old Count, from Eastside.
Almost as soon as Chelsea hears the three words "an old Count," her face becomes gloomy, and her smile vanishes.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: ...I've had nothing to do with him since a long time ago.
Even though you inherited his title and all his wealth?
She gives you a condescending glance, which is probably her actual self—the Countess Chelsea who roams around Eastside's vanity fair.
The Public Security Bureau has not found the old Count ever since. Everyone else present at the time is nowhere to be found either. Almost all the clues point to you.
Chelsea stares at you without saying a word, like a different person from before she entered the interrogation room.
She takes a few more glances at the photos on the table, then giggles and goes back to what she was like before.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Hahaha! Chief, if you think... I'm the reason why he's missing, I'll admit it.
After some inner struggling, Chelsea gives an answer that isn't really an answer.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: I really do like you, after all.

options: Do you have anything to do with it or not?

choices.text: Do you have anything to do with it or not?

steps.content: Chelsea fiddles with the gems in her hand and squints while her lips curl into an eerie smile.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Have a guess, my dear Chief. There's a reward for getting it right!
The reward. It isn't being your sugar baby or something, is it?

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Ah... You're ruining the fun.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: No reason. It serves him right.
You don't look like someone who has such a disregard for life.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Some lives can't be measured with gems, of course, but some others are different.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Unfortunately, for most people, their traces in the world can be erased with the right amount of money.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Now, Chief, your life is mine and mine only, of course.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: How unromantic, Chief.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: But I like it!
You ignore Chelsea and try to continue asking her questions, which makes her even more excited.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: My ability got awakened then. They seemed strong, but they were capable of nothing more than yelling. Killing them was a piece of cake.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: As for the bodies...
Chelsea pulls off a random strand of hair. A light shines in her hand once more, and the hair turns into a clear and shiny gem.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: See. I turned them all into gems just like this.
The Public Security Bureau closed the case as a missing person's case without even seeing the old Count's body? Did they not suspect anything?

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Does it matter where the old Count is and who the new one is? Anyone can be in this position with enough money.
Did you bribe them?

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: I did. This is what money can do. Money can silence literally anyone.
To a spendthrift like Countess Chelsea, bribing to get her way and make connections is probably something she takes for granted. However...

options: So, you want to silence me with your money too?

choices.text: So, you want to silence me with your money too?

steps.content: So you're trying to humiliate me by offering to be my sugar mama and give me gems?
Chelsea realizes you're really irritated and panics as she explains nervously.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: No, no, no. It's not like that. I-I didn't mean to humiliate you with money. Y-You're different. I just want you to have fun and be happy...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, it's a call from the city council about Countess Chelsea. It seems to be very urgent.
You glance at Chelsea, who scratches her head, seeming unaware of what's going on.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Is that the chief of the MBCC?
That's me.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: I heard that you have Countess Chelsea as your guest at the moment. I'd like to apply for bail for her.
She's a <color=#fb9259>dangerous Sinner</color> detained by the Bureau, and therefore not eligible for bail.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: A dangerous Sinner? She's a Sinner, but she isn't dangerous. Neither has she done any major crime. She's just had a few sugar babies, that's all. And the amount of bail can be negotiated...
The case is still under investigation. And we believe she has something to do with a case from earlier...

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Guess I'll have a chat with the higher-ups of FAC!
The councilor's voice raises sharply on the other end of the phone line.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Be careful when I do, Chief. There's no knowing how long you'll be able to stay in your position.
Thanks for your concern. I've got to go if there's nothing else. Excuse me.
Chelsea is no longer panicking when you hang up the phone. Instead, she gazes at you with her bright eyes.
Did you make this call happen with your money too, Countess?

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Wh-What call?
I don't care about money and power. I take full responsibility for all of MBCC's Sinners. You are not getting away.
Chelsea does not show any contempt or resentment at your words. Instead, she bursts out laughing. There's no trace of dismay on her face, and she even looks really delighted.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Okay, okay. I won't run away. I want to be with you for the rest of my life, after all!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, someone from the city council is here. They're at the door now.
They really waste no time. Looks like the interrogation will have to end here today.
Let's call it a day for now. I'll see you again when we've got more clues.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Sure! I'll be here whenever you need me, Chief.
On the way to the reception room, Nightingale speaks again.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, it seems that the news of the gem Sinner being at the MBCC has gotten out...
Hmm. The wealthy gem Sinner that everyone's after...
Your voices dissipate in the wind. You have a feeling that this won't be over that easily.
